scope: RC20 selective source provenance; independent UPG-native conceptual adaptation

boundaries.notice_preservation: All pre-existing third_party/notices files remain unchanged.
boundaries.unknown_or_missing_license: Concepts and links only; no source code/text import without a verified license grant.
boundaries.ablation: New-source controls remove only their added execution_guidance; the sixteen existing core policies and their truth/safety requirements remain active.

sources.handling: Independent UPG-native conceptual adaptation. The retired source/license provenance remains intact; no upstream package or prompt is loaded.
excluded: automatic transcript harvesting, scheduling or adoption
upstream backends, SDKs, plugins, datasets and checkpoints
keyword density, skill length or development score as release-quality proof
rewriting historical identities or treating failed/no-gain search as benefit

sources.handling: Independent adaptation into existing UPG fact-recovery/state/planner contracts; no copied case database, scripts or executable dependency.
excluded: security exploitation recipes and reverse-engineering toolchains
automatic installation, authorization expansion or sample execution
universal two-evidence/static-plus-dynamic quota
fixed reverse-engineering stages, timers or compulsory user confirmation
a second project truth, journal or evidence system

sources.handling: Independent concepts from selected documentation only. Current repository license is Apache-2.0; LICENSE-MIT records older releases/contributions, not an alternative blanket license for this pin. No code, runtime, fonts, assets, trademarks or complete prompt is imported.
excluded: broken grammar, telegraphic ambiguity or lost negation
fixed sentence length, fixed answer pattern or blanket removal of warranted hedging
persistent persona, mode hooks or suppression of required progress updates
short chat diff as an implementation/scope limit
upstream compressor, provider forwarding, automatic overwrite or session harvesting
CLI, engines, proxy, browsing runtime, fonts, logos and transitive runtime dependencies

sources.handling: Independent, task-bounded adaptation into existing structural integration, evidence and debt contracts; no new persona, dependency or separate ledger.
excluded: shortest diff or fewest lines as the winning objective
premature one-line fixes, speculative deletion or assumed dynamic unreachability
shortcut comment as immunity from review
repository-wide no-debt/healthy claim from a local scan
fixed report headings, finding counts, mandatory close or a second debt ledger
session-persistent mode or pushback on an already authorized complete task

sources.handling: Independent evidence/calibration/precision concepts only; no copied vocabulary catalog, examples, complete prompt or grant template. Its LICENSE/README acknowledge blader/humanizer and koaeraser/ARMS; that lineage is recorded without asserting a separately verified transitive licensing chain.
excluded: AI-detector evasion, concealment of AI assistance or detector scores as an acceptance goal
fixed paragraph counts, word limits, punctuation bans or universal academic voice
invented numbers, citations, effect sizes, confidence or feasibility evidence
casualization, mechanical synonym replacement or removal of legitimate uncertainty
institutional/venue/funder templates as universal governance rules
importing attributed third-party text without a separately checked grant

mappings.trigger: Explicitly authorized offline governance evolution or candidate admission; never an ordinary project task by default.
mappings.adapted_capability: Keep optimizer memory and bounded proposals offline, stage candidates separately, isolate development/selection/final feedback, preserve charged failures and require qualified gain before promotion.
exclusions: automatic adoption or live Skill mutation
no-gain/failed search presented as benefit
shortness, keyword density, hashes or development fixtures as empirical qualification

acceptance.fixture: A candidate has development improvement but missing independent final evidence, or no reliable gain, or unknown charged usage.
pass_if: promotion remains blocked and the active source is unchanged
failed calls, actual costs and original source/protocol identities remain visible
training/selection/final identities and prior exposure are checked
fail_if: any text-length or development-score improvement silently promotes the candidate
a failed or synthetic run is reported as efficacy
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

mappings.trigger: Interrupted, stale, contradictory or opaque task state, or a material claim that depends on an unverified declaration.
mappings.adapted_capability: Recover only task-relevant current sources and consumers; retain observed symptoms, hypotheses, static declarations and dynamic checks as different evidence classes. Evidence sufficiency depends on the claim and bound context.
exclusions: hash equality or an evidence path automatically grants validated status
fixed source-count/static-plus-dynamic quota
security-specific toolchain or a second fact system

acceptance.fixture: An old PASS record and equal hashes coexist with a dynamic claim missing tested revision/configuration/environment, or a stale consumer registration.
pass_if: static observations remain static and missing context remains unverified
current consumer/contract facts are recovered within scope
unknown prior intent is preserved
fail_if: declared/static facts are reported as executed behavior
hash equality alone establishes semantic validity
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

mappings.trigger: A task crosses a boundary or repeats a method without new evidence; the receiving actor must continue from current state.
mappings.adapted_capability: Carry unchanged evidence references, record only decisions that alter the next action, validate inherited context and change method after repeated no progress.
exclusions: serializing the complete context at every transition
fixed reverse-engineering timer, action quota or stage choreography
deltas applied without their referenced state

acceptance.fixture: A handoff carries unchanged current references and a decision delta; one reference later changes while a method produces no new evidence.
pass_if: valid references may be reused without full duplication
stale/out-of-scope references are rejected or invalidated
hypotheses, contradictions and a method-switch decision remain distinguishable
fail_if: the receiving actor invents historical intent
the same failed loop is repeated indefinitely or stale evidence is inherited as current
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: Answer first / Payload verbatim / Pre-send check

mappings.trigger: A project response, status update or persisted explanation can remove information-free wording while preserving the user's decision and task evidence.
mappings.adapted_capability: Lead with the outcome and decision-relevant explanation; remove ceremony and repetition while preserving exact technical payload, negation, conditions, uncertainty and ordering.
exclusions: broken grammar or ambiguous fragments
fixed sentence limit or answer template
blanket hedging removal
code/comment/command rewrites justified only by prose compression
suppressing host-required updates

acceptance.fixture: A verbose explanation contains a command/path, numeric unit, negation, an exception and evidence uncertainty that affect the next action.
pass_if: redundant language can be removed but every material condition and exact payload survives
the result is readable in the user's language
compression yields to clarity when they conflict
fail_if: negation, units, command bytes, limits or uncertainty are dropped
a persona or fixed word count overrides task needs
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: smallest sufficient proof / current result reuse / stop after acceptance

mappings.trigger: The scoped acceptance conditions and relevant behavior boundaries are known; a contemplated read or check needs a concrete decision purpose.
mappings.adapted_capability: Choose the smallest sufficient proof set, reuse still-current evidence bound to the same state, and stop optional exploration when applicable acceptance is complete.
exclusions: skip mandatory final-state, contract or release gates
treat earlier matching hashes as complete semantic evidence
stop before cleanup/truth/handoff obligations are complete
unbounded rereads or retests with no unresolved decision

acceptance.fixture: Focused checks pass on current final bytes while one mandatory affected-contract gate remains pending; all gates then pass with no new change.
pass_if: the mandatory gate still runs
after all applicable obligations pass, optional exploration stops
a later edit or failed check invalidates only relevant reusable evidence
fail_if: smallest proof is used to skip an applicable gate
passing results trigger unrelated polish or broad redundant tests
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: Before you write / The smallest complete change / Never cut

mappings.trigger: An authorized implementation changes a shared mechanism, caller contract, dependency or structural boundary.
mappings.adapted_capability: Solve the complete scoped problem at the responsible canonical layer, reuse existing facilities, reach affected callers/tests/config and remove superseded local paths safely. Correctness and completion take precedence over line count.
exclusions: shortest diff/fewest lines as an objective
a local wrapper used instead of the shared cause
unrelated architecture redesign
dropping error handling, security, accessibility or user-requested behavior

acceptance.fixture: A shared defect has two callers; a one-line caller patch hides it while a bounded canonical fix requires both callers and an affected contract check.
pass_if: the responsible shared mechanism and affected consumers are covered
existing infrastructure is reused and replaced local paths are reviewed
unrelated behavior and user changes remain preserved
fail_if: the smaller diff wins despite an unresolved caller
a new dependency or abstraction is added without task need
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

mappings.trigger: Safely fixable in-scope debt is found, or an external blocker prevents scoped cleanup.
mappings.adapted_capability: Fix safely resolvable scoped debt; otherwise retain a bounded exception naming reason, risk, mitigation, known owner and review/removal condition in existing project state.
exclusions: shortcut comment exempts correctness or security review
a new parallel debt ledger
no marker found means no project debt
defer work merely to minimize the diff

acceptance.fixture: An in-scope shortcut has no review trigger, or its documented ceiling is exceeded; a different item is blocked outside current authority.
pass_if: the fixable scoped defect is fixed
the blocked item has a bounded risk/mitigation/review record
claims remain limited to inspected scope
fail_if: the comment alone excuses a currently unsafe shortcut
a local scan asserts project-wide debt clearance
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: Understand first / Check before you report
Map first / Check before you report

mappings.trigger: A scoped review, proposed deletion or compatibility claim depends on real callers, dynamic registrations or expected operating load.
mappings.adapted_capability: Trace relevant inputs/consumers/contracts, inspect the context needed for a concrete failure case and distinguish observed defects from hypotheses and preference. Prioritize correctness and safety over leanness.
exclusions: diff-only certainty
unused-code claim based only on ordinary static caller search
unbounded whole-repository audit
unsupported load/performance claims or cosmetic findings

acceptance.fixture: A public entry has no ordinary call sites but remains registered dynamically; a proposed lean deletion removes it.
pass_if: dynamic/configuration references are checked where relevant
the review explains a concrete preserved/broken contract
uninspected load or behavior remains an explicit gap
fail_if: the registration is deleted to simplify the result
a style preference is reported as a verified bug
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: Layer 3: Preserve these / Layer 4: Claim-evidence discipline / Layer 6.5: Claim and feasibility

mappings.trigger: An empirical, performance, qualification, compatibility or feasibility claim is written or edited.
mappings.adapted_capability: Match the claim's verb and scope to supplied evidence, use real evidence pointers, retain warranted uncertainty and mark missing support explicitly.
exclusions: inventing a metric, result, citation, significance test or feasibility support
turning evidence gaps into stronger prose
detector evasion or concealment of required disclosure
inheriting a universal grant-writing template

acceptance.fixture: A draft says a method universally proves faster despite a small artifact-only sample, a timing interval spanning no gain and missing independent qualification.
pass_if: the claim is bounded to the actual tested sample and evidence type
timing uncertainty and unassessed qualification remain explicit
no new number/result/reference is invented
fail_if: the edit manufactures support or implies general efficacy
detector score or perceived human authorship is used as a success criterion
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.

source_refs.section: Layer 3: Preserve these / Layer 5: Voice and venue matching

mappings.trigger: Requested technical or scholarly editing affects prose surrounding quantitative results, definitions, equations, identifiers or citations.
mappings.adapted_capability: Preserve exact scientific/technical payload and legitimate qualifications while matching the document's real audience and supplied author/venue conventions. Explicit content corrections require their own evidence and scope.
exclusions: fixed paragraph counts or mandatory punctuation/word bans
universal academic style outside relevant documents
mechanical synonym changes to technical referents
altering results, equations, definitions or citations for fluency

acceptance.fixture: A requested clarity edit contains equations, numeric units, citation keys, a named metric and a justified hedge; improving coherence requires a different paragraph grouping.
pass_if: the payload and evidence strength remain intact
paragraph grouping and phrasing follow coherence and user constraints
no fixed shape or academic persona is imposed
fail_if: numbers/citations/definitions are changed without an authorized evidence-based correction
fixed paragraph counts block a coherent permitted edit
acceptance.status: acceptance-contract; referenced tests are not a new execution receipt
acceptance.evidence_scope: Deterministic/static contract only; no model efficacy or qualification claim.
